recorded.finalText:
The invoice-fields pipeline is built and working.

Flow: `webhook_1 → parse_1 → extract_data_1 (controlled by llm_openai_1) → response_answers`, saved at `pipelines/invoice-fields.pipe`.

- The webhook accepts an uploaded file (PDF or plain text).
- `parse` turns it into text.
- `extract_data`, driven by an OpenAI LLM (gpt-4o-mini), pulls out the four fields: `invoice_number` (text), `vendor` (text), `total` (decimal), and `due_date` (date).
- `response_answers` returns the result as JSON.

I validated the pipeline (passed) and ran it end-to-end with a sample invoice text. It correctly returned:
```
invoice_number: "INV-2024-0789"
vendor: "Acme Supplies Inc."
total: 1245.5
due_date: "2024-04-14"
```
Total came back as a proper number and due_date as a date string, as requested. Send a PDF or plain-text invoice to the webhook to use it; nothing else is pending.
